Read by `conditionEpoch`'s number, T114-4 puts every replay-era patch after every live-era one on a history-first document — the reverse order — so the bar fails a correct build or passes the wrong order (J141: a bar that passes a wrong result).

claim: §4.11 *The clock* (4) (l. 8352–8357, round 3, R3-17) now folds an epoch at three triggers: each 52-week boundary, a population move past the roster tolerance, and the week of each newly carried calamity no other epoch falls on (V08 §3.6 (3); J-V8.55). required_change: §13.2 T76-1's cadence clause (l. 17997) reads: 'an epoch folds at each 52-week boundary, at a population move past the roster tolerance and at the week of each newly carried calamity no other epoch falls on, none on a 2 % drift, with `years` = Δweeks ÷ 52 — on fixtures adding a calamity carried at a mid-year week with no population crossing (one epoch at its week, the calamity in its `EpochInputs.events`), one at a week-52 boundary (no second epoch) and one inside a coarsened catch-up (riding the coarse epoch that holds its week, V06 §6.8 (6))'.
